613K likes, 6,048 comments - aashnahegde on December 10, 2025: "8th Dec 2025 🤍 the day I got to marry the love of my life TWICE! 

Growing up I didn’t really believe in the institution of marriage. I never dreamed of having a wedding, never thought about a wedding lehenga but I’ve always dreamed of finding my person - my happily ever after! 
& my husband is everything I could wish for!
I don’t think it has really sunk in yet but my heart is so full that now I get to spend the rest of my life with my best friend! 
🤍
